Method of Attack: Phishing, typosquatting, and Trojanized ZIP archives hosted on Dropbox or OneDrive
Attack Vector: The malware is spread through search engine ads leading to fake sites. When clicked, users are redirected to a phishing site with a download link to the malicious software. The malware then impersonates legitimate software and makes use of reputable file-sharing services such as Dropbox to distribute the malware.
